author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
Streets of Rage? Turtles in Time? River City Ransom? BEAT EM UP! Anthony is back with another excellent 80s and 90s inspired game in the Tradersverse, a co-operative procedural combat game where your heroes fight waves of goons to eventually battle the boss!

Big thanks to Trader's Galaxy for the complimentary advance copy of the box to review. 

Check it out HERE: https://tradersgalaxy.com.au/what-is-beat-em-up/

author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
Welcome, bold adventurers, to a cheeky conversion of one of the 20th century’s great kitbash games to a bold new era. Mordheim you say? Well, we’ve got Mordheim at home with the release of the 2026 SPEARHEAD: City of Ash box. Why not make a conversion of the contents to play one of my favourite games? So here it is, the Warbands, Dramatis Personnae and eventually Scenarios and Exploration Tables to take to the ruined streets of Embergard in search of the riches of Emberstone Mines for your faction.

Check it out HERE: https://www.patreon.com/posts/emberheim-city-1-156322349
